title: Portfolio Pivot Framework: Q Planning for Hosted API & Model Catalog
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Purpose: Create a lightweight, repeatable Portfolio Pivot Framework to decide which hosted API endpoints and model-catalog additions move into the next quarter. The framework will prioritize initiatives by strategic OKR fit, operational cost, runway risk, and cross-team dependencies. Outcome: a prioritized commit list + a dependency map and a small decision rubric used in quarterly planning and stakeholder sign-off.
success_metrics: OKR alignment: >= 90% of prioritized items map to at least one Q2 OKR
Throughput: model onboarding time reduced from avg 18 days to <= 12 days
Operational: predicted unit cost variance <= 8% versus estimates for top-5 hosted endpoints
Reliability: no new top-10 customer-facing endpoints with >1% increase in p95 latency after rollout
milestones: 2026-03-12: Draft rubric and dependency template (this ticket)
2026-03-26: Final prioritized commit list + dependency graph published to Confluence/Drive
2026-04-02: Leadership sign-off and sprint allocations submitted to planning cycle
2026-04-09: Canary windows scheduled for top-3 model swaps and hosted endpoint changes
acceptance_criteria: A1: A one-page rubric (okrs, cost, risk, customer-impact) exists and is reviewed by PM and Eng leads
A2: A dependency graph in Drive that shows cross-team blockers and identifies mitigations for top-10 items
A3: Leadership sign-off recorded (email or doc) with any vetoed items and rationale
A4: The prioritized list is imported into Linear as child tickets or flagged with labels for the cycle
cross_functional_tasks: Eng: provide cost and latency estimates for candidate model variants
SRE: simulate capacity impact of top-3 hosted endpoints at +30% traffic
Design: review any API surface changes and doc updates
Sales/CS: validate customer commitments and map high-risk accounts
Security: confirm no new compliance blockers for private/dedicated deployment paths
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Model swap increases token cost beyond forecast. Mitigation: require a cost delta estimate and a rollback plan before canary.
Risk: Cross-team dependency on infra feature (autoscaler change). Mitigation: schedule parallel work and mark as hard dependency; include contingency reserve.
Risk: Feature quality regression in hosted API. Mitigation: attach a small eval set and quality gate to each model change; tie to release gating.
